title: A contiguity approach to replica symmetric marginals
summary: We develop a probabilistic cavity-contiguity framework for proving replica-symmetric convergence of local marginals in mean-field Gibbs systems. The approach is based on cavity decompositions of the Hamiltonian together with direct comparison of probability measures through Radon-Nikodym derivatives and Hellinger-type estimates. At a conceptual level, the method separates the concentration of the relevant order parameters from the identification of the asymptotic cavity model and the comparison of the associated Gibbs measures.
